title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7364 By Converting the Ilocos Regional Hospital to Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center, Further Increasing Its Bed Capacity to Three Hundred Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Ilocos Regional Hospital in San Fernando, La Union shall be converted into a teaching and training medical center and shall thereafter be known as the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center.
The bed capacity of said Ilocos Medical Center is hereby increased from two hundred (200) to three (300) hundred beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
